text: When to apply early March – early April Admission Upon acceptance, the University will send the "Notification of Admission to Peking University” and "Visa Application Form for Foreigners" (Form JW202) by the end of June. Registration Period September (the date of registration will be specified in the “Notification of Admission to Peking University”). Tuition fee and Housing fees 1. Tuition Fee: 26,000 RMB per year per person (teaching materials are not included), which must be paid in full on the day of registration. 2. Housing fees: Peking University provides students with accommodation in the Posts and Telecommunications Hotel, located 500 meters west of the main campus. Apartments: 58 RMB per day per bed. Two- or three-room apartment with two beds in each room, equipped with air conditioner, color TV, telephone, bathroom, and room-cleaning service. Single room: 95R MB per day per room.
